artists.source_line: Welcome to the next ILKSF festival and this one will be different.

features.rationale: The event lists workshops as part of what to expect.
A Semba Dance Battle is listed as part of the programme, which is a competition.
Named dress codes are given for each night, such as Samacaca for Friday Night.
Nights carry dress themes like All White and Black & Red Gala, which makes them themed parties.
